title: The grid line under a Pen point lights up while you draw
goal: When you draw with the Pen on a grid, nothing on screen says which lines caught the point: it just lands on a crossing. Dragging a box lights the line it came to rest on, so the Pen should say the same thing the same way while the run to the pointer is being aimed.
notes: Left rough by a-pen-point-lands-on-the-grid-line-you-can-see (2026-09-13). The pen sets PenSession.grid from CanvasNSView.canvasNudgeGrid and quantizes in PenSession.place; the drag path lights lines through annotationGridSnap plus refreshGridSnapLines (CanvasView.swift around 1100). The judgement call that was made without the user: lighting two lines on every mouse move while the pen preview is already tracking felt like noise, so it was left out. The audit 2026-09-13-pen-on-the-grid.json asks the user directly.
acceptance: With the grid on and the Pen in hand, the two grid lines the next point would land on light up as the pointer moves
They stop lighting the moment Command is held, because the point is then going exactly where the pointer is
The lighting is the same line, in the same colour, that a dragged box lights
A walk moves the pen across the grid and photographs the lit lines
